scientific_integrity: A complete analytic argument with a self-contained finite deterministic numerical/rational checker; the published stationary-transform theorem and classical Brownian reflection principle are credited.
scientific_limitations: Weak convergence for fixed positive parameters and strictly contractive bounded affine reset laws; no mean convergence, no slowly weakened contractions, and no independent publication-priority assessment.
title: Universal Gamma-half exit clocks above extreme levels under contractive Poisson resetting
